citation: Canfield-Dafilou & Abel, modal analysis of the Robert and Ann Lurie Carillon (University of Michigan), recorded October 2016
measurement_method: Modal decomposition into decaying sinusoids; CSV columns FREQUENCY, AMPLITUDE, DECAY, PHASE (frequency-sorted)
note: `decay_raw` is the source DECAY column verbatim. The page calls it an 'exponential decay rate' but the values fall with frequency like a time constant in seconds. Convention is unresolved, so no bandwidth or Q is derived from it.
